description: A submit button's label written `<INPUT TYPE="submit" VALUE="Send">`. The DOM draws an `<input type="submit">` labelled `Send` (measured through ngc in partial mode, the linker and a render in jsdom), so `value` speaks here. Each of the three names is upper case, so reading any one of the tag, `type` or `value` exactly lets the label through. The package entry is here so that the two reads agree.
